knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Cover, payroll registration and confirmed pay terms must be in place before the employee starts work. The other items are not prerequisites.
Grouping by area and using a slow day for distant work reduces travel the most. The other options increase it or do not address it.
Records in the business systems let work pass to someone else if a person leaves. The other options do not follow from keeping records.

practicalCriteria: Learner completes a start checklist for a sample employee, with each item marked confirmed and the source named.
Learner produces a weekly schedule that groups three sample jobs by area and shows the owner's times on site.
Learner records one weekly feedback entry, with an agreed action and a review date.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Learner rosters an employee to start work before cover and pay terms are confirmed.
Learner allows an employee to perform licensed work without a held licence.
